name: checkbox
useFor: Use for independent on or off choices that apply when a form is submitted (event subscriptions, consent). Pair each checkbox with a Label 8px to its right. Use the indeterminate state for a parent that covers some of its children. For a setting that applies at once use Switch.
constraints: A checkbox that acts immediately like a switch
source: Extrapolated from the Inkbox console (Figma 427:2715): the radios' 18px size and gray edge, the action purple and the white checks
title: Checkbox
description: An 18px box with 4px corners and a gray edge that fills purple with a white check.
